<thought>Search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates that, in the forward direction, form a C‑C double bond and break an aldehyde and an aliphatic carboxylic acid (consistent with the Doebner modification). Use the target molecule SMILES provided.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aldehydes", "aliphatic carboxylic acid"],
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
